text:
maya: quick sync  want to lock decisions on eval-signal thresholds + launch scoping for the Optimize toolkit pilot. can we pick granularity (per-model vs global), alert tiers, and auto-actions?

sam: i think per-model is required. different architectures + prompts will have different baselines. global will be noisy.

liam: +1 per-model. propose two window types: short (6h) for sharp regressions, long (24h) for slow drifts. detection metric = relative pct drop in pass-rate + absolute delta fallback.

ana: customers asked for: 1) ability to mute alerts per-customer 2) SLA-backed escalation (ticket + priority) 3) clear reason string in alert for why it fired.

sam: do we want automatic rollout pinning on hard alerts? e.g., if model A drops >7% pass-rate over 6h, pin to previous stable version and notify.

liam: we can wire to rollout policy. suggested rule (MVP): soft warning if delta>3% over 24h, hard if delta>7% over 6h. hard = auto-pin + pager, soft = slack + dashboard flag.

maya: that sounds reasonable. want to see a concrete config example we can hand to eng.

liam: example rule (YAML):
```
alert_rule:
  name: "eval-regression"
  scope: "model_id"
  metrics:
    - name: "pass_rate"
      compare: "relative"
  thresholds:
    - tier: "warning"
      delta_pct: 3
      window: "24h"
    - tier: "critical"
      delta_pct: 7
      window: "6h"
  actions:
    warning: ["slack_channel:optimize-monitoring"]
    critical: ["auto_pin_previous", "pagerduty:team-ml"]
```

nana: for customers please add: `mute_until` + `snooze_reason` fields on the alert API so account teams can pause noise during known experiments.

maya: decision proposal: adopt liam's two-tier thresholds as default, per-model evaluation only. implement customer mute and human ack. enable auto-pin only for critical tier. acceptance criteria:
- config-driven rules in prod config UI
- auto-pin runs and reverses if rollback success test passes
- mute API exists and honored by pipeline
- pilot enabled for 5 customers with no >10% false positive rate over 2 weeks

sam: rough effort: infra + metrics plumbing (2 wks), alerting + UI (2 wks), rollout/pinning integration (1 wk)  total ~5 weeks (2 sprints).

liam: MVP scope: eval ingestion -> daily baseline -> detection rules -> alert channel + auto-pin hook. Post-MVP: add model-specific sensitivity tuning, per-prompt slices.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline status: pilot-branch -> all checks passed, canary job queued.

maya: owners: sam (eng infra), liam (ml/regression logic), ana (customer config/requirements). next steps: sam open a GH epic + wireframes for alert UI, liam draft detection unit tests, ana collect pilot customer contact list. i'll spin up the product ticket.

sam: on it  creating epic now. will include the YAML example and perf SLO notes. :thumbsup:

nana: i'll ping customers to confirm mute/ack behavior and get 3 immediate pilot commitments.

liam: i'll add a tiny simulation harness to estimate false positive rates before we flip alerts on.

maya: great. plan: implement MVP -> run 2-week pilot -> review metrics and decide GA gating. thanks everyone.

sam: one quick Q  what do we consider a "pass" in pass_rate? liam, should we standardize on evaluator thresholds or let customers define?

liam: MVP: use our standardized eval/spec (binary pass per prompt). Post-MVP allow per-customer thresholds. we'll document the schema.

maya: ok locking that. meeting notes + action items going into product board. :white_check_mark:

sam: done  epic created: PRD + labels, link: https://prodboard/epic/OPT-1439

nana: noted, will share with customers.

maya: closing thread  we'll reconvene after sprint planning to confirm dates.
